observations: Black rectangular desktop with a slightly contoured front edge.
T-style metal legs in a black finish.
Integrated RGB LED lighting strip visible along the front edge of the desk.
A small control handset is mounted to the underside on the left side.
Power cables are visible running from the desk to a power strip on the floor.
The desk is shown at a standard sitting height.
The surface appears to have a matte or textured finish.

claims.claim: allows seamless transitions between sitting and standing
claims.evidence: The photo shows the desk at a single height; there is no video or sequence of photos showing it in motion.
While the shape and height adjustability are ergonomic features, comfort and fit cannot be verified remotely.

risks.proof: A video showing the desk moving from its lowest to its highest position and back.
A close-up photo or video of the control panel display lit up and responding to touch.

risks.risk: Instability or wobbling at standing height
risks.proof: A video of the desk at maximum height being lightly shaken to test stability.
Close-up photos of the desktop surface and edges.

proof_requests: Video of the desk's motor operating through the full height range.
Close-up photo of the control panel and any branding/labels on the underside.
Clear photo of the desktop surface to check for scratches or damage.
Photo of the desk at its maximum height.
response.reason: The desk's value is primarily driven by its motorized height adjustment and brand, neither of which can be verified from this single, distant photo. Without proof of a working motor, it must be treated as a standard fixed desk.
